name: mcp-claude-spotify
description: Control Spotify playback and manage your playlists from Claude.
long_description: A Model Context Protocol server for Spotify. Search the catalogue, control playback, read your top tracks and recently played, and create, edit, reorder and delete playlists including their cover art. Needs a Spotify app's client ID and secret; authorization runs once through a loopback callback on 127.0.0.1:8888 and the refresh token is stored owner-readable under ~/.spotify-mcp.

spotify_client_id.title: Spotify Client ID
spotify_client_id.description: Client ID from your app at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard. Add http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback as a redirect URI.

spotify_client_secret.title: Spotify Client Secret
spotify_client_secret.description: Client secret from the same Spotify app.
